# Grid Row Start / End

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

子项跨行。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: grid grid-cols-2 grid-rows-2 h-32 gap-2
    tpl: '<span class="row-span-2 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">跨两行</span><span class="bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">右上</span><span class="bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">右下</span>'
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `row-auto` | `grid-row: auto` |
| `row-span-1` | `跨 1 行` |
| `row-span-2` | `跨 2 行` |
| `row-span-full` | `grid-row: 1 / -1` |
| `row-start-1` | `grid-row-start: 1` |
| `row-end-3` | `grid-row-end: 3` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
